Group rides in Washington, DC

9 recurring group rides around Washington, DC: 6 road, 6 social. 5 roll on weeknights, 4 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with DC Queer Bike Rides in Washington — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Anacostia Park Paceline (APP) runs starts around 18 mph; speed rises every 4-mile loop.

I do the miles. You decide who they’re for.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, every one of them for queer communities. You pledge a few cents a mile and vote where the money goes. It starts January 1.
